title: Throat opening seen from inside
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite for Widow's Bay.
The way out of the whale seen from INSIDE its body: a round opening in pink-violet wet flesh, framed above by hanging baleen, bright daylight and a glimpse of rocky shore beyond. No outside skin, no eye, no barnacles, no jaw outline. The bottom of the opening is level, about 70% of the way down. Replaces whale-throat, which shows the whale's whole head from outside. Flat painted toy-theatre cut-out seen square-on, gouache on card with a faint pale cut edge; early-1900s stencil-tinted colour: sepia-grey line and tone with translucent washes of plum #2a1424, rose pink #f3c6dc, magenta #e0127a, moon gold #d9b34a, coral red #c8321e and grotto teal #5f8c88 laid slightly out of register; no cast shadow; no lettering; isolated on a transparent background (or flat pure magenta #FF00FF if transparency is unavailable).
Requested final aspect ratio 800:800. Real transparent alpha outside the isolated art.
Input image is a style/palette reference; follow the written subject and geometry rather than reproducing unwanted elements.
No text or watermark. A theatrical fantasy whale interior, no blood or injuries. Reference supplies lining colour only; show the internal exit framing daylight shore.
